findings.claim: The refinement log declares convergence ('all 6/6 archive constraints now pass') while every machine-readable record in the same diff records the sixth constraint as still pending review with only 5/6 satisfied.
findings.evidence: refinement_log.md added line: 'Reframed the sixth blocking constraint as claim truthfulness; all 6/6 archive constraints now pass...' contradicts validation.json ('status': 'review-in-progress', 'constraintsSatisfied': 5, formative-usability-claim 'pending-review'), state.json ('convergence_status': 'review-in-progress', goal 'pending-review'), reflection.json ('constraintsSatisfied': 5, decision 'continue-pending-fresh-review'), and artifact_manifest.json ('The claim-truthfulness constraint awaits a fresh distinct-model review').
findings.suggested_fix: Change the log entry to state that 5/6 constraints pass and the sixth awaits the fresh distinct-model review, or do not log convergence until validation.json actually records 6/6.

findings.claim: The revised 'Phase consequence' allows Task 12 to complete on the *existing* isolated-review and sycophancy evidence, but that evidence reviewed the pre-revision packet (which was blocked on the human study), not this revised packet — contradicting the packet's own requirement of a fresh review and Task 12's gate.
findings.evidence: certification-blocker.md: 'Task 12 may complete on the existing automated integration, documentation, artifact refinement, isolated-review, and sycophancy evidence.' This conflicts with dist/archive-qa-report.md ('Artifact Refiner will converge only after a fresh distinct-model review accepts the revised truthfulness contract'), reflection.json corrective action ('Complete KBD task 12 only after the revised documentation receives a fresh isolated review and sycophancy screen'), and acceptance criterion 12 ('verify and archive only when those gates pass').
findings.suggested_fix: Reword the Phase consequence to require a fresh isolated adversarial review and sycophancy screen of the revised packet before Task 12 completes, matching the rest of the diff.

findings.claim: The entire gate removal rests on a 'signed KBD decision v3-devtools-usability-gate-revised' and an 'operator-revision-receipt.json' that are cited as evidence but are neither included in this diff nor visible in the provided file tree, making the claimed operator authority unverifiable from the packet.
findings.evidence: validation.json evidence: 'Signed decision receipt operator-revision-receipt.json defers the zero-participant study...'; certification-blocker.md cites 'revision 437; plan revision 10 and phase revision 439'. The diff adds no such receipt or decision file, and the file tree lists .kbd-orchestrator/phases only as a directory. The prior certification-blocker.md stated the criterion was 'non-waivable... changing or removing it requires a new explicit design decision and adversarial review' — that design-decision artifact is not present here.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the signed decision record and operator-revision-receipt.json (with revision identifiers) in this change, or downgrade the evidence wording to reflect that the receipt is pending.

findings.claim: specification.json retains the measurable outcome 'packed browser scenarios: 5/5 pass' while the rest of the revised packet reports six scenarios passing, leaving threshold/outcome drift in a file this diff edits.
findings.evidence: specification.json measurable_outcomes: { "metric": "packed browser scenarios", "threshold": "5/5 pass" } vs artifact_manifest.json notes ('Six assembled browser scenarios pass'), dist/archive-qa-report.md ('assembled gate passed 6/6 scenarios'), and refinement_log.md (6/6 at commit cbb3946...).
findings.suggested_fix: Update the threshold to '6/6 pass' to match the actual assembled gate contract.

findings.claim: The artifact has reached its declared iteration cap (current_iteration 5 of max_iterations 5) yet the diff continues refinement under 'review-in-progress' without recording any cap extension or exception.
findings.evidence: state.json: 'current_iteration': 5, 'max_iterations': 5, 'convergence_status': 'review-in-progress'; reflection.json delta admits 'The prior artifact remained blocked at its iteration cap'; refinement_log.md nonetheless appends a new 'Operator revision and convergence' iteration entry at 2026-08-30T12:02:52Z.
findings.suggested_fix: Either record an explicit iteration-cap extension tied to the operator revision, or close the loop at the cap and track the fresh review outside the refinement loop.
